definitions.collision: Contact of a robot footprint with a human disc or a robot footprint, closed sets, counted as episodes.
definitions.separation_violation: Gap to a human below 0.5 m, counted as episodes. A collision is also a violation.
definitions.near_miss: No contact and a gap below 0.2 m, counted as episodes.
definitions.stop_episode: A tick where the requested speed is above zero and the limited speed is zero, after a tick where it was not. Counted per robot.
definitions.false_stop: A stop episode that starts while the centre distance to every human minus the human radius is above 3.0 m.

notes: Development seeds only. Every control value is an assumption, not calibrated. Reflex limits (watchdog, geofence, e-stop) are off in E1. Throughput is waypoints reached per simulated hour. distance_m is the path length of all robots and speed_ratio the limited over the requested speed per control call; both read slowing without the waypoint cliff.
